sections.en: 1 κὶν δὺν σώζη ('danger saves') the codex has. κίνδυνον σώζει ('saves from danger') I have written. 3 τὴν κεʹ ἡμέραν ('the 25th day') the codex has, corrected by Kroll. 4 ἤ ('or') bracketed by me. 5 τὸν ('the') added by Kroll, compare below. 6 κατοψεύσαντος ('having lied against') the codex has, κατοπτεύσαντος ('having observed') I have written. 8-9 ἀμφικίρτου ('gibbous') the codex has. 9 διαπέμπτος ('fifth apart'), διάτριτος ('third apart') (see 4, 120, 26) are lines connecting some sign with that which is third or fifth from it [Kroll]. ᾗ ('to which') I have written, ἡ ('the') the codex has. 12-13 κἀνθρέψης λούσης οἰνοδοτήσης ('and if you nourish, wash, give wine') the codex has, it seems to have been a corrupt hexameter [Kroll]. 15 υγια ('health') the codex has. 17 τε ('and')] τι ('something') the codex has. 19 εἰς ('into') added by Kroll, compare below. 24 after ἀγαθοποιῶν ('benefics'): ηθείη ('might be') the codex has, θεωρούντων ('observing') I have written. νοήσαντες ('having perceived') the codex has. 26 σχηματίζεται ('is configured') the codex has. 28 ὅτ’ ἂν ('whenever') the codex has. κινεῖται ('moves') the codex has. 29 ἡ δὲ ('but the') the codex has, corrected by Kroll. 30 εἰς ('into') added after κοιλίαν ('belly'): πτα ('pta') the codex has, κατ ('down') corrected by Kroll. 31 ἐπείδοι ('might look upon') the codex has. 34 ff. compare Hermet. Trism., III, 23. παρέλκη ('might drag along') the codex has.

summary.headline: Astrological Medical Prognoses
summary.text: Astrological medical prognoses for lunar relationships with Mars, Saturn, Mercury, the Sun, and benefics, including disease duration, danger, salvation, and treatment outcomes in Leo, Gemini, and Cancer.
